validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort of men with an initially negative prostate biopsy followed for incident prostate cancer, reporting alcohol intake as a modifiable dietary risk factor.

extraction.population: Men with an initially negative prostate biopsy in the Health Professionals Follow-up Study

sample_size.excerpt: In total, 10,396 participants of the Health Professionals Follow-up Study with an initial negative prostate biopsy after 1994 were followed for incident prostate cancer until 2017.

cases.excerpt: With 1851 prostate cancer cases (168 lethal) diagnosed over 23 years of follow-up, the 20-year risk of any prostate cancer diagnosis was 18.5% (95% CI: 17.7-19.3).

comparison.excerpt: Higher BMI and lower alcohol intake tended to be associated with lower rates of localised disease.
